描述_EN: a significant quantity of both green-glazed stoneware and blue-and-white porcelain has survived there today. large dishes were made primarily for sale to the countries of central or south-east asia. at that time the yongle emperor sent seven expeditions from china to south-east asia and the middle east, led by the eunuch admiral zheng he. historians believe that large dishes of this type were given as diplomatic gifts. this dish is a fine example of blue-and-white porcelain from the early 15th century. the chinese usually served food in small or medium-sized dishes, but not large ones such as this.
描述_ZN: 大量的绿釉石器和青花瓷至今仍保存在那里。 大盘子主要是为了出售给中亚或东南亚国家。 当时永乐皇帝在宦官郑和的带领下，七次从中国出征东南亚和中东地区。 历史学家认为，这种类型的大盘子是作为外交礼物赠送的。 这个盘子是15世纪初青花瓷的一个好例子。 中国人通常用小型或中型盘子盛装食物，而不是像这样的大盘子。
